strongest_angle: Anthropic launched Claude Motion and Claude Dashboards in October 2026, enabling Team and Enterprise plan users to instantly generate 30-second animated video explainers and live-updating data dashboards directly from text prompts.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic released Claude Motion and Claude Dashboards in beta on October 8, 2026, allowing users to create video explainers and charts.
Claude Motion is available in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, where it comes turned on by default on Team plans.
Anthropic launched the new workplace productivity tools on October 8, 2026, as reported by Reuters on Yahoo Finance.
Claude Docs, Slides, and Design tools are out of beta and available on every Claude plan, including the Free tier.
